green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 Then I looked online and found a report → Later, I searched for a proper study and found a review Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded version replaces vague words like ‘a report’ with more precise research vocabulary such as ‘a proper study’ and ‘a review’, which makes the checking process sound more credible.升级后的版本把含糊的 ‘a report’ 换成更精确的研究类词汇，如 ‘a proper study’ 和 ‘a review’，让核实过程听起来更可信。
  • 7–8 → 9+ It taught me to be cautious → that lesson has made me far more sceptical of confident-sounding claims Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The final version turns a generic moral (‘be careful’) into a specific lesson about doubting confident-sounding but untested claims, which gives the answer sharper content and a stronger ending.最终版本把笼统的道理（要小心）变成关于质疑听起来自信但未经检验的说法的具体教训，内容更有力，结尾也更扎实。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I was happy that I checked. → I was glad I had taken the time to check before spreading the claim Listenability好懂程度
    The longer clause explains what the speaker was glad about and why, with a clear ‘before’ structure, so the listener follows the reasoning more easily than with a short flat sentence.较长的从句清楚说明了说话人为什么感到庆幸，并用 before 结构交代先后顺序，听者比听简单平淡的短句更容易跟上思路。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often say ‘believe someone’s words’, and learners tend to translate this literally as ‘believe her words’. The more natural expression is ‘take her word for it’, a fixed collocation that is very common in speech.中文里常说“相信某人的话”，学习者容易直译成 believe her words。更自然的说法是 take her word for it，这是一个固定搭配，口语里很常用。
  • When talking about research evidence, distinguish a ‘study’ (a single piece of research) from a ‘review’ (a summary of many studies). ‘Systematic review’ sounds more precise in a Level 9 answer, but use it only when you really mean that many studies were combined.说到研究证据时，注意区分 study（单项研究）和 review（对多项研究的综述）。在 Level 9 的回答里，用 systematic review 能显得更精确，但只有在你确实想表达“汇总了许多研究”时才用。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I felt very sad → I was completely overwhelmed Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 7 version replaces a plain feeling word with a stronger, more precise expression, so the listener understands how intense the situation was.7分版本用更精确、更有力的表达代替了简单的情绪词，让听者更清楚当时的压力有多大。
  • 7–8 → 9+ After that conversation, I felt much calmer → That talk lifted a huge weight off my shoulders Listenability好懂程度
    The Level 9 version uses a natural idiom and a clear image, which makes the result sound vivid and easy to follow instead of just stating a feeling.9分版本使用了自然的习语和生动的画面，让结果听起来更形象、更容易理解，而不只是陈述一种感觉。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 He told me to take a rest → He gently encouraged me to step back and rest Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The Level 8 version adds detail about how the father offered support, which makes the content richer and more convincing.8分版本补充了父亲如何给予支持的细节，使内容更丰富、更有说服力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When telling a personal story, many learners only say they felt sad, but more specific words such as overwhelmed or under pressure make the description richer.讲个人经历时，很多学习者只说『我很难过』，其实可以用 overwhelmed、under pressure 等更具体的词，让描述更有层次。
  • Keep your tenses consistent: when you talk about something that happened last year, stay in the past tense from start to finish.注意过去时态要一致：讲去年发生的事情时，从头到尾都用过去式，不要中途变回现在式。

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 it was very hard for me → it was much more difficult than I had expected Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 5 version says the task was ‘very hard’, which is flat. The upgrade uses a comparison with an expectation (‘much more difficult than I had expected’), which is more precise and sounds more natural and complete.5级版本只说“很难”，比较平淡。升级后用“比我预想的难得多”这种与预期对比的结构，表达更精确、更自然。
  • 7–8 → 9+ felt really proud of myself → beaming with pride Vocabulary词汇
    ’Felt really proud of myself’ is correct but plain. ‘Beaming with pride’ is a vivid, idiomatic image that shows the feeling instead of just naming it.“felt really proud of myself”正确但平淡；“beaming with pride”是生动地道的表达，用画面展示情绪，而不只是说出情绪。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 After one month, I could play a simple song. → Within a month, I was able to play a simple song from start to finish. Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    ’After one month, I could play a simple song’ is vague. The upgrade adds a clearer time frame and a concrete detail (‘from start to finish’), which makes the progress easier for the listener to picture.“一个月后我能弹一首简单的歌”比较笼统。升级后加入了更清晰的时间范围和具体细节（从头到尾），让听者更容易想象进步的过程。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When you talk about starting a hobby, ‘learn the guitar’ stresses the learning process, while ‘play the guitar’ describes performing. To say you began a new hobby, ‘take up’ sounds more natural than ‘start’.说“开始学吉他”时，learn the guitar 强调学习过程，play the guitar 强调演奏本身；想表达“开始养成一个新爱好”，可以用 take up，比 start 更地道。
  • ’Give up’ is the common way to say you wanted to quit, while ‘throw in the towel’ is more colourful and informal. One or two idioms in a whole answer is enough; do not pile them up.表达“想放弃”时，give up 很常用，throw in the towel 更口语、更形象，适合冲击高分的表达，但整段只用一两个习语就够了，不要堆砌。

Prompt题目 28

Talk about a time when you felt lonely and a friendship helped you. 谈谈你曾经感到孤独、友谊帮助了你的一次经历。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe the situation and why you felt alone.描述当时的情况以及你感到孤独的原因。
  2. Explain what your friend did.解释朋友做了什么。
  3. State what the experience changed.说明这次经历带来的改变。

Three sample answers on the same plan同一骨架的三级示范

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1 74 words词

I felt lonely when I moved to a new neighbourhood. I knew few people and spent many evenings alone. I assumed nobody wanted to listen. One friend called me every week. We talked about small things and kept in touch. At first, I was embarrassed, but I felt heard after our calls. She did not solve every problem. However, she made me feel less alone. I learned that friendship can begin with small actions.

CELPIP 7–8 · ≈B2 115 words词

A few years ago, I moved to a new neighbourhood and felt surprisingly lonely. Although I had people around me, I did not know anyone well enough to share difficult feelings. I became quiet and assumed that others were too busy. One of my old friends noticed that I was out of the loop and began calling every Sunday. We kept in touch, spoke about ordinary events, and gradually discussed my situation. Hearing that someone had made time for me made a difference. She could not solve every problem, but her support helped me build confidence in the community. Because I knew exactly when we would speak again, my week felt more predictable and welcoming.

A few years ago, I moved to a new neighbourhood, where my physical surroundings changed far more rapidly than my sense of belonging. Although there were people nearby, I had no relationship close enough to make me feel heard. I gradually withdrew and even assumed that others were too busy to listen. Fortunately, an old friend noticed that I felt out of the loop and began calling me every Sunday. Rather than offering quick solutions, she listened, remembered small details and kept in touch. What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I knew few people → I did not know anyone well enough to share difficult feelings Content / Coherence内容与连贯

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I was worried → I felt quite anxious about falling behind Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The new wording names the feeling more precisely and also explains what the speaker was afraid of, which adds meaningful content.新表达更准确地说出了情绪，还交代了说话人具体担心什么，使内容更充实。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I started to feel comfortable → everything finally clicked Vocabulary词汇
    This idiomatic expression conveys the sudden moment of understanding far more vividly than a plain statement about comfort.这个地道表达生动地传达了豁然开朗的那一刻，比单纯说感觉适应了更有表现力。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 showed me some basic steps → walk me through the main features Vocabulary词汇
    This phrasal verb pattern is natural workplace English and suggests patient, step-by-step guidance through specific functions.这个短语动词结构是自然的职场英语，能体现对具体功能耐心、逐步的讲解。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Keep the past tense when telling a past experience. For a situation that had already been true for some time before then, use the past perfect, as in ‘I had relied on the old system for years’.讲过去的经历时要保持过去时；如果要说更早以前就一直如此的情况，可以用过去完成时，例如 I had relied on the old system for years。
  • ’Having relied on...’ is a participle clause that gives a reason. Its implied subject must match the subject of the main clause.Having relied on... 是分词结构，用来交代原因。注意它的逻辑主语必须和后面主句的主语一致。
  • Ending with a lesson and linking it to what you do now makes the answer feel complete.结尾用一句话总结收获，并联系到今后的做法，能让回答显得完整。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 At first I was very clumsy → At first I was hopelessly clumsy Vocabulary词汇
    ’Hopelessly clumsy’ is a stronger, more precise collocation than ‘very clumsy’.hopelessly clumsy 比 very clumsy 更精准、搭配更地道。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 She did not get angry → she never lost her patience Vocabulary词汇
    The idiom ‘lose patience’ sounds more natural and shows the grandmother’s character.lose patience 更自然，也更能体现奶奶的性格。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 so she could see my cousin → so that she could keep in touch with my cousin overseas Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    This version adds the purpose and the detail ‘overseas’, so the story is clearer.这个版本补充了目的和 overseas 的细节，故事更清楚。
  • 7–8 → 9+ she offered to teach me how to make dumplings from scratch → she insisted on teaching me to make dumplings from scratch Vocabulary词汇
    ’Insisted on’ adds feeling and a gerund pattern, which sounds more varied.insisted on 带有情感色彩，并使用动名词结构，更富变化。
  • 7–8 → 9+ the dough kept sticking to my fingers → the dough clung to my fingers like glue Listenability好懂程度
    The simile makes the picture vivid and easy for the listener to imagine.比喻使画面生动，听者容易想象。
  • 7–8 → 9+ we discovered that we had more in common than I had expected → we found common ground I had never expected Vocabulary词汇
    The fixed chunk ‘common ground’ is shorter and more idiomatic than a long clause.common ground 这一固定搭配比长从句更简洁地道。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • The pattern ‘What impressed me was that...’ lets you highlight the point that stood out most.用 What impressed me was that... 的句式，可以把最让你印象深刻的一点突出出来。
  • Using ‘In return’ shows that both sides gave something, which gives the story shape.用 In return 说明双方互相给予，能让故事有来有往，更有层次。

Prompt题目 31 Trips and directions出行与问路

Talk about a time when you got lost or had difficulty finding your way while travelling. Where were you going, what went wrong, how did you find your way, and what did you learn from the experience? 讲述一次你在旅行途中迷路或难以找到正确路线的经历。你当时要去哪里？出了什么问题？你是如何找到正确方向的？这次经历让你学到了什么？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe the destination and explain why you were unfamiliar with the area.介绍目的地，并解释自己为什么不熟悉那个地方。
  2. Explain what went wrong and how you asked someone for directions.说明途中发生了什么问题，以及你如何向别人问路。
  3. Describe how you eventually reached your destination and what you learned.描述你最终如何到达目的地，以及从中学到了什么。
Chunks from the same topic you could use可以用上的同主题词块
  • route /ruːt/ 路线；路径
    Travel experts recommend checking the route before starting a journey. A Better Way to Find Your Way
  • also /ˈɔːlsəʊ/ 也；还（通常放在动词前、be 动词后）
    She also pointed out a colourful building that would help me recognise the correct street. The Wrong Turn That Helped Me
  • journey /ˈdʒɜː.ni/ 行程；旅程；从一地到另一地的旅行
    The journey looked simple, and I expected to arrive in less than half an hour. The Wrong Turn That Helped Me
  • transport /ˈtrænspɔːt/ (n.), /trænˈspɔːt/ (v.) 运输；交通；运送
    Many people now use mobile map applications, but local transport information and street signs remain important. A Better Way to Find Your Way
  • travel /ˈtræv.əl/ 旅行；旅游；出行
    Since that day, I have paid more attention to landmarks and local advice when travelling. The Wrong Turn That Helped Me

Three sample answers on the same plan同一骨架的三级示范

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1 76 words词

Last spring, I took a bus to a museum in a city I did not know. I got off one stop too early because I misunderstood the announcement. I checked the map on my phone, but the streets looked confusing. Then I asked a woman at a bus stop for directions. She showed me the right street and explained where to turn. I arrived ten minutes late, but I learned to check the route before leaving.

CELPIP 7–8 · ≈B2 116 words词

Last spring, I took a bus to a museum in an unfamiliar city. I got off one stop too early because I misheard the announcement. At first, I tried to follow the map on my phone, but the street names and turns were hard to match with what I could see. Rather than keep walking in the wrong direction, I asked a woman waiting at a nearby bus stop for help. She pointed out the correct street, described the next two turns, and reminded me to cross at the traffic lights. I reached the museum about ten minutes late, but the experience taught me to check my route in advance and listen carefully for stop announcements.

CELPIP 9+ · ≈C1 129 words词

Last spring, I was taking a bus to a museum in a city I barely knew. Distracted by the view, I missed the announcement and stepped off one stop too soon. I pulled up the map on my phone, yet the street layout still did not make sense on the ground. Instead of wandering and hoping for the best, I asked a woman at a nearby bus stop to point me in the right direction. She identified the street, talked me through two turns, and told me to cross at the lights. I arrived roughly ten minutes late, slightly embarrassed but relieved. More importantly, I learned that a map is only useful when I match it to landmarks around me, and that asking a clear question can save time.

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I misunderstood the announcement → I misheard the announcement Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded expression uses a more precise verb to explain the misunderstanding. Mishearing an announcement describes an auditory problem more naturally than the general idea of misunderstanding it.升级后的表达使用了更加准确的动词来解释误会。Mishear 强调听错了广播内容，比笼统地说没有理解广播更具体，也更符合这个场景。
  • 7–8 → 9+ the experience taught me to check my route in advance and listen carefully for stop announcements → I learned that a map is only useful when I match it to landmarks around me, and that asking a clear question can save time Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The final version develops the lesson beyond simply checking a route. It explains how to connect a digital map with real-world landmarks and adds a practical insight about asking clear questions.最终版本将经验教训从简单的提前查看路线提升为如何把电子地图与现实地标结合起来，并进一步指出清楚地提出问题能够节省时间，使结尾更有深度。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 the streets looked confusing → the street names and turns were hard to match with what I could see Listenability好懂程度
    The intermediate version replaces a vague description of confusing streets with a more concrete explanation of the difficulty of matching street names and turns to visible surroundings. This makes the story easier to imagine.中级升级版本不再笼统地说街道令人困惑，而是具体解释街道名称和转弯方向难以与眼前环境对应的问题，使听众更容易理解当时的困难。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Mishear and misunderstand are different. Mishear means failing to hear something correctly, while misunderstand means receiving information but interpreting its meaning incorrectly.Mishear 和 misunderstand 有区别。Mishear 表示没有听清或听错了声音内容；misunderstand 表示听到了或读到了信息，但没有正确理解其含义。
  • Could you point me in the right direction? is a natural and polite way to ask for general directions. If you need more detailed instructions, you can follow up with Where should I turn?问路时可以使用 Could you point me in the right direction? 这是一种自然且礼貌的表达，适合询问大致方向。若需要详细路线，可以继续询问 Where should I turn?
  • Notice the difference between get off and get on. When travelling by bus or train, get on means to board, while get off means to leave the vehicle. Useful expressions include get off at the wrong stop and get off one stop too early.注意 get off 和 get on 的区别。乘坐公交车或火车时，get on 表示上车，get off 表示下车。描述坐过站或提前下车时，可以使用 get off at the wrong stop 或 get off one stop too early。

Prompt题目 32 Ideas of a good life关于好生活的想法

Talk about a time when you changed your idea of what a good life really means. What happened, and what did you learn from it? 请讲一讲你改变了对“好生活”真正含义的看法的一次经历。当时发生了什么？你从中学到了什么？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe your old life and why it did not feel good描述你以前的生活，以及它为什么并不让你感到美好
  2. Explain the moment or event that made you rethink your priorities说明让你重新思考优先事项的那个时刻或事件
  3. Share how your life is different now and the lesson you learned分享你现在的生活有何不同，以及你得到的启示

  • also /ˈɔːlsəʊ/ 也；还（通常放在动词前、be 动词后）

  • require /rɪˈkwaɪə/ 需要，要求

  • tend to /ˈtend tə/ 往往；倾向于
    The excitement of buying something new often fades, whereas meaningful relationships and a sense of purpose tend to provide more lasting satisfaction. Beyond Material Success
  • while /waɪl/ 而（表示对比）；当……时

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1 82 words词

Last year I had a job with a high salary. I worked very long hours and I was always tired. I had no time for my family or my friends. One day my mother called me and said she missed me. I felt sad. Last year I held a well-paid job, yet the hours were so punishing that I was perpetually drained. I barely had a moment for my family, let alone my closest friends. One quiet evening my mother phoned and gently admitted she missed me, and that hit me like a punch to the stomach. I made up my mind to walk away from that career and settle for a less demanding role on a smaller salary. green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 left that job → step away from that job Vocabulary词汇
    The phrasal expression ‘step away from’ sounds softer and more natural than the plain verb ‘left’, and it shows the decision was deliberate rather than sudden.“step away from”这个短语动词比简单的“left”更委婉自然，也体现出这是深思熟虑的决定，而不是一时冲动。
  • 7–8 → 9+ not just about earning money → a good life cannot be measured by a pay cheque Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    Instead of a simple ‘not just about money’ statement, the upgrade states a clear, memorable principle about how a good life is measured, which gives the ending real depth.升级后的说法不再只是“不只是为了钱”，而是提出了一个清晰、令人难忘的衡量好生活的原则，让结尾更有深度。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I am happier now → I feel far more content with my daily life Listenability好懂程度
    A fuller clause with a degree adverb and a specific noun phrase is easier for a listener to follow and sounds more natural than a short, flat sentence.带有程度副词和具体名词短语的完整从句，比简短平淡的句子更便于听者理解，也更自然。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese a speaker may simply say that they quit, but in spoken English phrases like step away from or walk away from sound softer and more like natural storytelling.中文里常说“辞职了”，英文口语里可以用 step away from、walk away from 这类表达，语气更柔和，也更像地道的叙述。
  • When telling a personal story, time markers such as Looking back or These days show listeners exactly where the story turns, which helps your listenability and coherence.讲个人经历时，用 Looking back 或 These days 这类时间标记，可以让听者清楚知道故事在哪个时间点转折，听力和连贯性得分会更高。

Prompt题目 33 Seeing a doctor看病就医

Talk about a time when you went to see a doctor and had trouble explaining how you felt. What happened, and how did you solve the problem? 请讲讲你有一次去看医生，却很难把自己的感觉说清楚的经历。当时发生了什么？你是怎么解决这个问题的？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Say why you went to the clinic and how you felt before the visit.说明你为什么去诊所，以及看诊前的感受。
  2. Describe the difficulty explaining your symptoms and how you solved it.描述你在说明症状时遇到的困难，以及你是怎么解决的。
  3. Finish with the result and what you do differently now.最后说说结果，以及你现在有什么不同的做法。

Last year I was knocked flat by a nagging cough that dragged on for about two weeks, so I finally dropped into a walk-in clinic near my home. I was anxious because my English was far from fluent. The doctor fired off a series of detailed questions, and I struggled to put my symptoms into words. I felt embarrassed and a little helpless at that moment. green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I felt very sad → I felt embarrassed and a little helpless Vocabulary词汇
    A precise emotion phrase shows your feelings more clearly than a basic word like sad, and it fits the situation of struggling to communicate.用更精确的情绪表达，比“sad”这种基础词更能说清当时的感受，也更贴合“沟通困难”的情境。
  • 7–8 → 9+ After that, I felt much better → Within days I was back on my feet Vocabulary词汇
    An idiom about recovery sounds natural and vivid, and it replaces a plain statement with something a native speaker would actually say.用一个关于康复的习惯用语，比平铺直叙更自然生动，也更接近母语者的说法。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 She understood me and gave me medicine. → She patiently went through my notes, explained what was wrong, and prescribed some medication Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    Adding what the doctor actually did, such as reading your notes and explaining the problem, gives the story more detail and makes the answer more convincing.补充医生具体做了什么（看笔记、解释病情），让故事内容更充实，也更有说服力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people say they go to look at a doctor, but the natural English expressions are see a doctor or go to a clinic. Do not translate it word for word as look at a doctor.中文里常说“我去看医生”，英语里更自然的说法是 see a doctor 或 go to a clinic；不要直译成 look at a doctor。
  • When describing symptoms, say I have a cough or I have a sore throat. Use the verb have, not be, before the symptom.描述症状时，用 I have a cough 或 I have a sore throat 比 I am cough 更正确；症状前面通常用 have，而不是 be。

Prompt题目 34 How institutions work制度怎么运转

Talk about a time when you experienced a problem with an institution or organization and had to find out how its procedures worked. What happened, how did you deal with the situation, and what did you learn from the experience? 讲述一次你在某个机构或组织遇到问题，并需要了解其办事程序的经历。当时发生了什么？你是如何处理的？你从这次经历中学到了什么？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe the broken hallway lights and the frustration among residents.描述走廊灯损坏的情况，以及居民对此产生的不满。
  2. Explain how you asked questions and helped establish a clearer reporting procedure.解释你如何提出问题，并帮助建立更加清晰的报修程序。
  3. Describe the outcome and explain why transparent procedures matter.描述最终结果，并解释为什么透明的办事程序很重要。

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1 87 words词

Last year, I joined a residents' meeting about repairs in our apartment building. People were upset because the hallway lights had been broken for weeks. I learned that clear procedures help people trust an institution.

Last year, I took part in a residents' meeting about repairs in our apartment building. Frustration had been mounting because the hallway lights had remained broken for weeks. Some neighbours immediately faulted the building staff, but the real problem was that nobody could see how a maintenance request was processed or who was accountable at each stage. More importantly, the meeting showed me that institutional trust depends on transparent processes, clear responsibility, and consistent communication, not on assurances alone.

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 nobody knew how repair requests were handled → no one understood how maintenance requests moved through the system Vocabulary词汇
    The upgrade replaces a basic description of not knowing a procedure with more precise language about understanding how requests move through an administrative system. This introduces useful institutional vocabulary and makes the explanation more natural.升级后的表达不再只是简单描述不知道某个程序，而是更准确地说明人们不了解请求如何在行政体系中流转。这既增加了实用的制度类词汇，也使表达更加自然。
  • 7–8 → 9+ keeping people informed → consistent communication Vocabulary词汇
    The final version uses a more concise and abstract expression to describe ongoing communication. It fits the broader discussion of institutional trust and demonstrates more precise vocabulary.最高级版本使用更加简洁、抽象的表达来描述持续沟通。这种说法更符合制度信任这一较为宏观的讨论，也体现了更精准的词汇运用。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 report problems in one place → use one shared channel for reporting problems Listenability好懂程度
    The revised expression is more specific about the mechanism residents use to submit complaints. It also connects more smoothly with the following explanation of reviewing progress.修改后的表达更加具体地说明了居民通过什么方式提交问题，也能更自然地衔接后面关于检查处理进度的内容。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Institution is a general noun for an established organization or system, while institutional is an adjective commonly used in expressions such as institutional trust and institutional responsibility.institution 是机构或制度组织的统称，而 institutional 是形容词，常用于 institutional trust（制度信任）和 institutional responsibility（机构责任）。
  • When describing an administrative process, logged, assigned, tracked, and verified create a clear sequence of actions: recording, allocating, monitoring, and confirming.描述行政流程时，logged、assigned、tracked 和 verified 可以形成清晰的动作链，分别表示登记、分配、跟踪和核实。
  • Earn trust is more natural than simply saying get trust because it emphasizes that an institution must gain confidence through its actions and consistent performance.earn trust 比简单使用 get trust 更自然，强调机构需要通过实际行动和长期表现来赢得信任。

Prompt题目 35 Investing and risk投资与风险

Talk about a time when you made an investment or money decision that felt risky. What happened, and what did you learn from it? 请谈谈你做过一次让你觉得有风险的投资或理财决定。发生了什么？你从中学到了什么？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Explain why you wanted to invest and what you chose.说明你为什么想投资，以及你选择了什么。
  2. Describe the risk and how you felt when the value changed.描述风险，以及价值变化时你的感受。
  3. Share the lesson you learned and how you act now.分享你学到的教训，以及你现在的做法。

  • fall /fɔːl/ 跌倒；摔跤

  • tend to /ˈtend tə/ 往往；倾向于

  • time horizon /ˈtaɪm həˌraɪzn/ 投资期限；时间跨度
    The point is to take risks that you understand, in amounts that you can bear, over a time horizon that gives you room to recover. Beware the Sure Thing

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I was nervous because I did not know much about stocks → I felt uneasy, since I had barely any experience with the stock market Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded phrase replaces simple words with more precise ones and links the feeling to its cause with a smoother structure, which sounds more natural and fluent.升级后的说法用更精确的词汇替换了简单词，并用更流畅的结构把感受和原因联系起来，听起来更自然。
  • 7–8 → 9+ weigh the risks → size up the downside before putting a single dollar at stake Vocabulary词汇
    The final phrase is more idiomatic and vivid. It shows clearly what the speaker does and why, instead of using a general verb with a vague object.最后这个说法更地道、更生动，清楚表达了说话者做了什么、为什么这样做，而不是用笼统的动词加模糊的宾语。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 The price went down at first, and I felt worried → the price dipped almost immediately, which shook my confidence Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgrade adds a clearer picture of the problem. It says how fast the price fell and how that affected the speaker, which makes the story richer and easier to follow.升级后的说法把问题描述得更具体：价格下跌得多快，以及对说话者的影响，使故事更丰富、更容易听懂。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often say that the risk is very big. In spoken English it sounds more natural to say it felt risky or the downside was real, instead of always saying very big risk.中文里常说“风险很大”，英文口语中可以更自然地说 “it felt risky” 或 “the downside was real”，不必总用 “very big risk”。
  • When telling a personal story, openers such as looking back or in the end introduce the result and the lesson, which makes the structure clearer and easier for listeners to follow.讲个人经历时，用 “Looking back” 或 “In the end” 引出结果和教训，能让故事的结构更清楚，听众也更容易跟上。
  • The phrase afford to lose is a useful collocation in investing topics. It means that losing the money would not damage your daily life.“afford to lose” 是投资话题里很实用的搭配，表示这笔钱即使亏掉也不会影响生活。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 He said the wall was damaged, but it was not true → he claimed the wall was damaged, which simply wasn’t the case Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded version replaces a blunt statement with a more precise reporting verb and a relative clause, so the speaker sounds more natural and controlled.升级后的说法用了更精确的转述动词和关系从句，听起来更自然、更有控制力。
  • 7–8 → 9+ the decision went in my favour → the ruling vindicated me completely Vocabulary词汇
    A single strong, idiomatic phrase for the result sounds more confident and precise than a general statement that the decision was favourable.用一个有力、地道的短语描述结果，比笼统地说裁决有利更自信、更精确。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I was angry, so I took photos and wrote down everything → Rather than losing my temper, I documented everything with dated photos and notes Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgrade turns a simple emotion plus action into a contrast, showing self-control and adding detail about how the evidence was kept.升级后用对比结构代替简单的情绪加动作，体现自控，并补充了证据保存方式的细节。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often say simply that the law is fair, but in spoken English it is more natural to explain what made the process feel fair, such as both sides getting a chance to speak. This is more specific and scores better.中文里常说法律是公平的，但英语口语里更自然的做法是说明过程让你感到公平，例如双方都有机会陈述。这样内容更具体，也更容易得分。
  • Keep the whole story in the past tense and do not slip into the present tense between verbs such as kept and claimed.押金一词在英语里是 deposit，讲故事时要用过去时贯穿全程，不要在 kept、claimed 之间混用现在时。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 My teacher told me to speak more → My teacher encouraged me to practise outside the classroom Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 7 version replaces a plain instruction with a more precise verb and a clear purpose, so the listener understands both what the teacher did and why it mattered.7 分版本用更精确的动词和明确的目的取代了简单的指令，听者能同时明白老师做了什么以及为什么重要。

    The Level 9 version makes the result more concrete and natural. A specific, vivid achievement is more convincing than a general statement.9 分版本把成果说得更具体、更自然。具体而生动的成就比笼统的陈述更有说服力。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I felt nervous but I tried → Although my heart was racing, I forced myself to keep going Listenability好懂程度

Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • The most common obstacle for adult language learners is fear of mistakes. In a speaking task, naming that feeling directly, for example terrified of making mistakes, is more convincing to raters than just saying shy.成年人学语言最常见的障碍是怕犯错。在口语题里，直接说出这种情绪（比如 terrified of making mistakes）比只说 shy 更能打动评分员。
  • All three versions tell the same story. The way to raise your score is not to add new events but to say the same ideas more precisely, more naturally and with richer structure.三个版本讲的是同一个故事。提分的关键不是加新情节，而是把同一个意思说得更精确、更自然、结构更丰富。

Prompt题目 38 Language, thought and culture语言、思维与文化

Talk about a time when you experienced or witnessed a misunderstanding between people from different cultural backgrounds. What happened, how was the misunderstanding resolved, and what did you learn from the experience? 讲述一次你亲身经历或目睹的、发生在不同文化背景的人之间的误解。当时发生了什么？误解是如何解决的？你从这次经历中学到了什么？

  3. Explain what the experience taught you about cultural context, tone, and communication.说明这次经历让你对文化背景、语气和交流有了哪些认识。

Last year, I joined a community book club where people spoke several languages. At first, I thought everyone understood the same idea in the same way. During one discussion, a member used a phrase that sounded rude to me, but she was only being direct. I asked what she meant, and she explained the cultural context. Instead of reacting, I asked her to clarify what she meant, and she explained the cultural context behind her choice of words. From then on, I paid closer attention to tone and asked questions before drawing conclusions. The experience showed me that language does more than convey information: it can also reflect the habits, values, and assumptions of a community.

She explained the cultural context and the conversational norms behind her wording. That exchange made me more attentive to tone, implication, and the assumptions listeners bring to a conversation. What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I thought everyone understood the same idea in the same way → I had assumed that people would interpret an idea in much the same way, regardless of their background Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The higher-level version makes the speaker's initial assumption more explicit and connects it to cultural background. This gives the story a clearer central conflict rather than simply describing confusion.升级后的表达更明确地说明了说话者最初的假设，并将这种假设与文化背景联系起来，使故事的核心冲突更加清晰，而不只是简单描述困惑。
  • 7–8 → 9+ asked questions before drawing conclusions → asking questions before passing judgment Vocabulary词汇
    The advanced version uses more precise and idiomatic language to describe thoughtful communication. The wording conveys a deliberate effort to understand others rather than merely avoiding an argument.高级版本使用了更准确、更地道的表达来描述理性交流，强调主动理解他人的态度，而不仅仅是避免争论。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I asked what she meant → I asked her to clarify what she meant Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The intermediate version explains the speaker's response more clearly by showing an intentional request for clarification. This makes the sequence of events easier to follow and strengthens the connection between the problem and its resolution.中高级版本更清楚地展现了说话者主动寻求澄清的过程，使事件发展更容易理解，也加强了问题与解决方式之间的联系。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Struck me as rude is a natural expression meaning that something gave you the impression of being impolite. Here, struck describes a sudden impression rather than a physical action.struck me as rude 是一个自然的表达，意思是某件事给人留下了粗鲁的印象。struck 在这里表示某种感受突然出现在脑海中，而不是字面上的击打。
  • Rather than take offence means choosing not to feel insulted immediately. Take offence is a fixed expression commonly used to describe feeling upset by someone's words or actions.Rather than take offence 表示不急于感到被冒犯。take offence 是固定搭配，常用于描述对他人的言语或行为感到不快。
  • Language is more than a neutral vehicle for information is an effective way to express an abstract idea. Vehicle is used metaphorically to describe something that carries or communicates meaning.Language is more than a neutral vehicle for information 是一种抽象但有力的观点表达。vehicle 在这里是比喻，表示承载或传递某种内容的媒介。

Last summer, while I was helping my mom clear out my grandmother’s apartment, I stumbled upon a faded photograph buried in a shoebox. There was Grandma, beaming outside a tiny bakery, her apron dusted with flour. I was stunned, having taken it for granted that she’d spent her whole life as a homemaker. As it turned out, she’d run that business for a decade, getting up long before dawn to keep the family afloat. That evening, over a pot of tea, I coaxed her into reminiscing, and out poured memories that had never made it onto paper. The experience completely reshaped my image of her. It also brought home to me how fragile family history is: unless someone bothers to ask, a whole chapter of a person’s life can quietly vanish.

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I thought she only stayed at home → I had always assumed she was a full-time homemaker Vocabulary词汇
    The past perfect with ‘always assumed’ shows a long-held belief that was later overturned, and ‘full-time homemaker’ is far more precise than a description of staying home.过去完成时搭配 always assumed，表现出一个长期持有、后来被推翻的看法；full-time homemaker 也比单纯说待在家里准确得多。
  • 7–8 → 9+ stories that nobody had ever written down → memories that had never made it onto paper Listenability好懂程度
    The image of memories never reaching paper is vivid and idiomatic, and it ties naturally to the theme of history that could be lost.用记忆从未落到纸上这一表达，形象而地道，并自然呼应了历史可能失传的主题。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 worked very hard to support her family → often started before sunrise to keep her family afloat Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    A concrete detail about starting before sunrise shows the hard work instead of merely stating it, and ‘keep her family afloat’ is a natural idiom.天不亮就开工这一具体细节让辛劳看得见，而不只是直接陈述；keep her family afloat 是自然的习语，意为维持一家生计。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Both ‘come across’ and ‘stumble upon’ mean to find something by chance, and the latter is more vivid. The object follows the whole phrase, so a pronoun should not split it.come across 和 stumble upon 都表示偶然发现，后者画面感更强；两者后面直接接宾语，中间不要插入代词。
  • When telling a past story, use the past perfect for events that happened before the discovery, such as running the bakery, which came earlier than the point in the narrative.讲过去的故事时，发生在发现照片之前的事要用过去完成时，例如经营面包店这件事早于叙述中的时间点。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I looked for the answers on the government website → We searched the official government website until we found clear answers to each question Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 7 version replaces a vague, simple search statement with a more precise one that shows effort and result: searching until clear answers were found. It sounds more natural and gives the listener more detail.7 分版本用更精确的表达取代了简单笼统的说法，既说明了努力过程（一直查到找到答案），也交代了结果，听起来更自然、信息更丰富。
  • 7–8 → 9+ a little help can go a long way → even a modest gesture can make the whole transition feel lighter Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 ending turns a common saying into a fresher, more specific idea about how a small gesture changes the whole transition. This shows precise, varied vocabulary and a more thoughtful conclusion.9 分版本的结尾把常见的俗语换成了更新颖、更具体的表达，说明一个小举动如何改变整个适应过程，词汇更精准、多样，结论也更有深度。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 She was very happy and thanked me → She was so relieved that she could not stop thanking me Listenability好懂程度
    The Level 8 sentence uses a result clause with so...that, which links the feeling to the action. This makes the speech smoother and easier to follow than two short, separate statements joined by and.8 分版本使用 so...that 结果状语从句，把情绪与行为联系起来，比用 and 连接的两个简短句子更流畅，听者也更容易理解。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often say that a favour helped a great deal, and learners may translate this word for word into an unnatural phrase. More natural English is a little help can go a long way, or it meant a lot to her.中文里常说「帮了大忙」，学习者容易直译成 helped a big busy。更自然的说法是 a little help can go a long way 或 it meant a lot to her。
  • When telling a personal story, keep the past tense throughout, and switch to the present tense only for general truths in your conclusion, such as settling into a new country is stressful.讲个人经历时要用过去时贯穿全文，只有在总结感悟时才可以转到现在时，例如 I realized that settling into a new country is stressful。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I did not check my spending → I had lost track of what I was spending Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgraded sentence describes the problem more precisely: losing track of spending is a clearer cause than simply not checking.升级后的句子把问题描述得更准确：“对开销失去掌控”比单纯的“没检查”更清楚地说明了原因。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I felt stressed for months → The debt hung over me for months and kept me awake at night Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgraded sentence adds a vivid personal detail about the effect on daily life, which makes the story more convincing and memorable.升级后的句子加入了对日常生活影响的生动细节，让故事更有说服力、更令人印象深刻。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I paid a small part → I only managed to cover the minimum payment Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded phrase uses the precise banking term for the smallest amount you must repay, instead of a vague description.升级后的短语使用了银行业的准确术语来表示必须偿还的最低金额，取代了含糊的描述。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often say that someone has no sense of how much they spend. In English, the natural way to say this is to lose track of what you are spending, which sounds better than a word-for-word translation.中文里常说“花钱没数”，英语中可以用 lose track of what you are spending 来表达，比直译更自然。
  • Notice the difference between a bill and a statement. A statement is the record of transactions sent by a bank or card company. In speech people mix the two, but statement sounds more natural when you talk about credit cards.注意 bill 和 statement 的区别：statement 是银行或信用卡公司寄来的账单明细，口语中两者常混用，但在谈信用卡时用 statement 更地道。

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 She was angry, and I was angry too → Tensions were running high on both sides Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded phrase describes the mood of the whole situation in one precise, neutral expression instead of repeating the simple word ‘angry’ for each person. It sounds more mature and avoids blaming either side.升级后的短语用一个准确而中性的表达描述整体气氛，而不是对两个人都重复使用简单的 angry，听起来更成熟，也不会指责任何一方。
  • 7–8 → 9+ listening carefully → listening with genuine curiosity Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 phrase adds a precise manner (‘with genuine curiosity’) to the idea of listening, which shows a more specific attitude and sounds more natural and idiomatic than a plain adverb.9 分版本在 listening 后加入了表示态度的具体说法（with genuine curiosity），比单纯的副词更精确、更地道。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 we shared the work and made a small plan → we divided the tasks according to our strengths and agreed on a clear timeline Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgraded version gives concrete content: how the work was divided and that a clear timeline was agreed. Specific details make the story more convincing than the vague idea of making a small plan.升级后的版本给出了具体内容：任务如何分配、约定了明确的时间表。具体细节比含糊的 made a small plan 更有说服力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often say they quarreled with someone, but in English ‘argue’ sounds casual. To describe a conflict in a more formal way, ‘disagreement’ or ‘be at odds with’ sounds more natural.中文常说和某人吵架，但英语里 argue 偏口语，描述正式场合的分歧时，用 disagreement 或 be at odds with 更自然。
  • Say ‘reach a compromise’ or ‘meet in the middle’. Do not say ‘make a compromise’.compromise 常说 reach a compromise 或 meet in the middle，不要说 make a compromise。

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 The prices were very high → The rents were well beyond my budget Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 7 version describes the problem in terms of the speaker’s own budget, which is more precise and natural than a vague ‘very high’, and it shows the real effect on the speaker.7 分版本用“超出了我的预算”来描述问题，比笼统的“很高”更准确自然，也说明了对说话人的实际影响。
  • 7–8 → 9+ a small place close to the train station → a bright, compact suite within walking distance of the station Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 version replaces a plain description with more vivid, specific wording, so the listener can picture the home and its location clearly.9 分版本用更生动、具体的措辞取代了平淡的描述，让听者能清楚想象出这处住所及其位置。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 I signed the paper the next day → I did not hesitate and signed the lease the following morning Listenability好懂程度
    Showing that you acted decisively, with a clear sequence of ideas, makes the story easier to follow and sounds more natural than a short flat statement.表现出果断行动，并让想法顺序清晰，比一句简短平淡的陈述更易听懂，也更自然。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In spoken English, say ‘look for a place’ or ‘apartment hunting’ rather than translating word for word. In Canada, people ‘rent an apartment’, and a ‘lease’ is the rental agreement.“找房”口语里常说 look for a place 或 apartment hunting，不要逐字翻译成 find house。在加拿大，租房通常说 rent an apartment，而 lease 指租约。
  • From Level 5 to Level 9 the story stays the same; only the wording becomes richer, with clauses and fixed phrases such as ‘well beyond my budget’ and ‘ticked every box’. Learning these chunks is more effective than memorising single words.从 Level 5 到 Level 9，故事内容保持不变，只是把简单句升级为带从句和固定搭配的表达，例如 well beyond my budget、ticked every box。背熟这些搭配比单纯背单词更有效。

Prompt题目 46 Media and persuasion媒体与说服

Talk about a time when you changed your mind about something because of what you saw or read in the media, such as an advertisement, a news story or a video. 请谈谈你曾经因为在媒体上看到或读到的内容（例如广告、新闻报道或视频）而改变想法的一次经历。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe the advertisement or media message you first saw and how you felt描述你最初看到的广告或媒体信息，以及当时的感受
  2. Explain what you found out when you checked other sources解释你查证其他来源后发现了什么
  3. Say what you learned and how your habits changed说说你学到了什么，以及你的习惯发生了什么变化

  • although /ɔːlˈðəʊ/ 虽然；尽管（后面不能再接 but）

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 My friend told me to wait → Fortunately, a friend persuaded me to hold off Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 7 version uses a more natural and precise reporting verb with a phrasal verb, which shows the friend actively changed the speaker’s mind instead of just giving a simple instruction.7级版本使用了更自然、更精确的动词和短语动词，表明朋友确实改变了说话人的想法，而不只是简单地给出一个指示。
  • 7–8 → 9+ check more than one source → cross-referencing several sources Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 phrase is more precise and sounds more like an educated speaker. It names the exact research habit of comparing several sources instead of using a general phrase.9级的表达更精确，听起来更像受过教育的说话者。它点明了对比多个来源这一具体的查证习惯，而不是用笼统的说法。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 The battery was not good → The battery drained within a few hours Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The Level 7-8 version replaces a vague judgement with concrete, specific detail about the battery, which makes the story more vivid and convincing.7-8级版本用关于电池的具体细节取代了模糊的评价，使故事更加生动、更有说服力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Chinese speakers often say they simply bought what was in the advertisement. In English it sounds more natural to say you were influenced by an advertisement or fell for it, which carries the idea of being swayed.中文学习者常说“我买了广告里的东西”，英文里更自然的说法是 be influenced by an advertisement 或 fall for an advertisement，带有“被影响、被吸引”的意思。
  • When telling a personal story, use the past tense for the events, then the present perfect, as in ‘Since then, I have...’, to show the lasting change. This makes your timeline much clearer.讲个人经历时，要用过去时讲故事，再用现在完成时（如 Since then, I have...）说明这件事带来的长期变化，这样时间线会更清楚。

Prompt题目 47 Routines and habits作息与习惯

Talk about a time when you changed one of your daily habits to make your life better. What was your old habit? Why did you decide to change it? What did you do, and how did the change affect your daily life? 讲述一次你为了改善生活而改变某个日常习惯的经历。你原来的习惯是什么？你为什么决定改变它？你采取了哪些行动？这次改变对你的日常生活产生了什么影响？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Explain your old habit and how it affected your mornings.介绍你原来的习惯，以及它如何影响你的早晨。
  2. Describe the steps you took to build a better routine.描述你为建立更好的作息习惯采取了哪些步骤。
  3. Share the improvements you noticed and what you learned.分享你注意到的改善，以及你从中学到了什么。

  • feel /fiːl/ 感觉；摸起来；感到

  • habit /ˈhæbɪt/ 习惯
    I have learned that a useful habit should support real life, not become another source of pressure. The Evening I Changed My Habits
  • prepare /prɪˈpeə(r)/ 准备
    I arrived home, prepared something quick to eat, and sat down with my phone. The Evening I Changed My Habits
  • also /ˈɔːlsəʊ/ 也；还（通常放在动词前、be 动词后）
    I also put my phone in another room while studying. The Evening I Changed My Habits

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 rushed every morning → started each morning in a rush Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded expression uses a more natural sentence structure to describe a stressful morning. It communicates the same experience more smoothly than the original wording.升级后的表达使用了更自然的句型来描述早晨的匆忙。它在保留原意的同时，比原来的表达更加流畅。
  • 7–8 → 9+ made my mornings feel less stressful → brought a surprising sense of calm Vocabulary词汇
    The upgraded expression communicates an emotional result more vividly. The phrase creates a stronger impression than simply describing a reduction in stress.升级后的表达更加生动地传达了情绪上的变化。与单纯描述压力减轻相比，这种表达更有画面感，也更能体现语言的细腻程度。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 hard to stop watching videos → resisting the temptation to watch videos was difficult Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The revised wording explains the difficulty more precisely by identifying the temptation behind the habit. This adds a clearer reason for why changing the routine required effort.修改后的表达更准确地指出了改变习惯时面临的诱惑，让听者更清楚地理解为什么建立新作息需要付出努力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • When describing an old habit, you can use used to + base verb, such as used to stay up late. To describe a new habit you are maintaining, you can use keep doing something or stick with a plan.描述过去的习惯时，可以使用 used to + 动词原形，例如 used to stay up late。描述现在正在坚持的新习惯时，可以使用 keep doing something 或 stick with a plan。
  • When describing a change in habits, do not simply list what you did. Organize your answer into three stages: the old habit, the actions you took, and the final results. This makes your story more complete.讲述习惯改变的经历时，不要只罗列做了什么。最好按照过去的习惯、改变的行动和最终结果三个阶段组织答案，这样故事会更完整。
  • Notice the difference between routine and habit. A habit usually refers to one particular behavior, while a routine usually refers to a daily schedule made up of several habits.注意区分 routine 和 habit。Habit 通常指某个具体习惯，而 routine 通常指由多个习惯组成的日常安排。

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 We talked for twenty minutes → We sat down together for a candid conversation Vocabulary词汇
    The upgrade replaces a plain, vague statement with a more natural phrase that sounds like a real, honest conversation, which gives the listener a clearer picture and shows a wider vocabulary range.升级后的说法用更自然的短语取代了平淡含糊的表达，让听者更清楚地感受到那是一次坦诚的交谈，也体现了更丰富的词汇。
  • 7–8 → 9+ he seemed much happier and more confident → he had truly come out of his shell and was beaming with confidence Vocabulary词汇
    The upgrade swaps a general description for an idiomatic expression with a vivid image, which is more precise and memorable and is typical of top-level speaking.升级后用一个形象的习惯用语取代了笼统的描述，更精准也更令人印象深刻，是高分口语的典型特征。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 She said she would help him → She promised to pair him with a friendly classmate and keep a close eye on him Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The upgrade turns a short, general promise into a specific action with a concrete detail, so the story has richer content and sounds more convincing.升级后把简短笼统的承诺变成带有具体细节的行动，故事内容更丰富，也更有说服力。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • Chinese speakers often translate the idea of talking with a teacher word for word and repeat one simple verb. Try more natural collocations such as reach out to, sit down with, and have a frank talk.中文说话者常把想表达的意思直译成英语，例如把‘跟老师沟通’说成‘communicate with the teacher’的简单重复。可以多用 reach out to、sit down with、have a frank talk 等更地道的搭配。
  • When telling a story about the past, keep the past tense consistent, and use time connectors such as in the meantime and within a few weeks to make the story flow clearly.讲述过去的经历时，要保持过去时态一致，并用 in the meantime、within a few weeks 这样的时间连接语让故事更有条理。

Prompt题目 49 Sleep, stress and mental health睡眠、压力与心理健康

Talk about a time when stress made it hard for you to sleep. What happened, what did you do about it, and what did you learn from the experience? 请讲一讲压力让你难以入睡的一次经历。发生了什么？你是怎么应对的？你从中学到了什么？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Set the scene: a stressful project and sleepless nights交代背景：压力很大的项目和失眠的夜晚
  2. Explain the effects: tiredness, bad mood, poor focus说明影响：疲惫、情绪差、注意力不集中
  3. Describe the solution and the lesson: talk to someone, build a bedtime routine描述解决办法和收获：与人沟通、建立睡前习惯

  • body clock /ˈbɒdi klɒk/ 生物钟

  • sleep pressure /sliːp ˈpreʃə/ 睡眠压力（困意的累积）
    Sleep scientists describe two forces that work together: sleep pressure and the body clock. Two Forces That Decide When You Sleep

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 we changed the deadline → explained my situation to my manager and we agreed on a more realistic deadline Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The Level 7 version replaces a vague action with a concrete one. It says what you explained and what was agreed, so the listener can picture the solution.7分版本把模糊的动作换成具体内容，说明你向经理解释了什么、双方达成了什么共识，听者更容易想象出解决办法。
  • 7–8 → 9+ my mood improved → I felt like a new person Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 phrase is an idiomatic expression of change. It sounds natural and shows more range than a plain statement about mood.9分版本用了地道的习惯表达来描述变化，比单纯说情绪好转更自然，也更能体现词汇的丰富度。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 stop using my phone → put my phone away an hour before bedtime Listenability好懂程度
    The Level 8 phrase gives a clear, specific habit with a time reference instead of a general instruction. Specific details make the answer easier to follow and sound more fluent.8分版本给出了带时间参照的具体习惯，而不是笼统的做法。具体细节让回答更容易听懂，也更流畅。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often say the pressure is big. In English, use the pressure was intense or I was under a lot of stress, and do not translate word for word as the pressure is very big.中文里常说“压力很大”，英文里可以用 the pressure was intense 或 I was under a lot of stress，不要逐字翻译成 the pressure is very big。
  • When you tell a story about the past, keep the past tense throughout. Used to can show a past habit, for example I used to scroll through my phone in bed.讲过去的经历时，要全程使用过去时；used to 可以表示过去的习惯，比如 I used to scroll through my phone in bed。

Prompt题目 50 Art and taste艺术与品味

Talk about a time when you visited an art gallery or exhibition and had to choose a piece of art that you liked. Describe what you saw, explain why you preferred that particular artwork, and share how other people's opinions influenced your decision. 谈谈你曾经参观艺术画廊或展览，并需要从中挑选一件自己喜欢的艺术作品的经历。描述你看到了什么，解释为什么你更喜欢那件作品，并分享其他人的意见如何影响了你的决定。

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe the gallery visit and explain why you needed to choose an artwork.描述参观画廊的经历，并解释为什么你需要挑选一件艺术作品。
  2. Explain the artwork's colours, composition, and personal appeal.介绍作品的色彩、构图，以及它对你的个人吸引力。
  3. Describe other people's reactions and explain your final decision.描述其他人的反应，并解释你最终作出的选择。
Chunks from the same topic you could use可以用上的同主题词块
  • explain /ɪkˈspleɪn/ 解释；说明
    Visitor: I suppose that explains why two people can disagree so strongly about the same work. Who Decides What Is Beautiful?
  • while /waɪl/ 而（表示对比）；当……时
    Some visitors see an abstract painting in a quiet gallery, while others encounter the same image alongside historical photographs. Beyond First Impressions: Rethinking Artistic Taste
  • taste /teɪst/ 尝起来；味道；品尝
    Taste tends to reflect personal histories as well as broader social influences. Who Decides What Is Beautiful?
  • also /ˈɔːlsəʊ/ 也；还（通常放在动词前、be 动词后）
    The work also involves memory, movement, and cultural context. Who Decides What Is Beautiful?
  • suggest that /səˈdʒest ðət/ 表明；暗示
    Early observations suggest that visitors often respond differently when they receive information about an artist's intentions. Beyond First Impressions: Rethinking Artistic Taste

My cousin preferred a quiet landscape, so we discussed both choices. I asked two visitors what they noticed first. In the end, we chose the bright painting because it suited the open, friendly space. green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I liked the bright painting → I was drawn to the painting's vivid colours Vocabulary词汇
    The higher-level version replaces a basic description of liking a painting with more precise language about visual appeal. The expression conveys a stronger personal reaction and sounds more natural in an art discussion.升级后的表达不再简单地说喜欢一幅画，而是更准确地描述视觉吸引力。这种说法能够传达更具体的个人感受，也更适合艺术讨论的语境。
  • 7–8 → 9+ listened to their opinions → I weighed their interpretations carefully Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The advanced version presents the speaker as someone who carefully evaluates different interpretations rather than simply hearing opinions. This adds intellectual depth and demonstrates an understanding of subjective artistic judgment.高级版本将说话者表现为能够认真权衡不同解读的人，而不只是听取别人的意见。这增加了表达的思想深度，也体现了对艺术判断主观性的理解。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 It looked nice → Its composition felt balanced Listenability好懂程度
    The upgraded wording introduces a specific observation about visual composition instead of relying on a vague positive reaction. It makes the explanation more descriptive and easier for a listener to picture.升级后的表达加入了对视觉构图的具体观察，而不是停留在笼统的正面评价上。这使描述更具体，也让听者更容易形成画面感。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • I was drawn to is a natural expression for describing aesthetic appeal. It conveys how something attracted your attention more effectively than I liked. It can also describe architecture, music, and design.I was drawn to 是描述审美吸引力的自然表达，比 I liked 更能体现某件作品如何吸引你的注意。它也可以用于描述建筑、音乐和设计。
  • Composition refers to the arrangement of visual elements in an artwork. It is commonly used when discussing painting and photography. A balanced composition means the arrangement feels harmonious rather than simply attractive.Composition 指艺术作品中不同视觉元素的组织方式，常用于讨论绘画和摄影。Balanced composition 表示构图协调，而不是简单地说画面漂亮。
  • Taste is subjective is a useful expression when discussing artistic preferences. Subjective emphasizes personal feelings and judgments, whereas objective refers to facts or standards that are independent of personal opinions.Taste is subjective 是讨论艺术品味时非常实用的表达。Subjective 强调个人感受和判断，而 objective 则强调客观事实或标准。

Talk about a time when you had to decide whether to use a new technology even though you had worries about privacy. What was the situation, what did you decide, and what did you learn from it? 请讲一讲你曾在对隐私有顾虑的情况下，需要决定是否使用某项新科技的经历。当时的情况是什么？你做了什么决定？你从中学到了什么？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe the technology and why you were worried about privacy描述这项科技，以及你为什么担心隐私
  2. Explain what you and others did to check the risks and decide说明你和他人如何核查风险并做出决定
  3. Share the result and the lesson you learned分享结果以及你学到的教训

  • tend to /ˈtend tə/ 往往；倾向于

  • held accountable /held əˈkaʊntəbl/ 被追究责任

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I talked to my parents about it → So I sat down with my parents and we went through the terms of service line by line Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The upgrade turns a vague action into a clear, concrete step. Reading the terms of service line by line shows exactly how the decision was made, which fulfils the task better.升级后的表达把含糊的行为变成了具体清晰的步骤。逐行阅读服务条款准确说明了决定是如何做出的，更好地完成了任务要求。
  • 7–8 → 9+ but we became much more cautious about what we share → yet we now think twice before sharing anything Listenability好懂程度
    The new phrase is an idiomatic way to describe a changed habit. It sounds natural and easy to follow while showing a more flexible command of English.新的短语是描述习惯改变的地道说法，听起来自然、容易理解，同时展现了更灵活的英语运用能力。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 We turned off some settings that we did not need → Together we switched off several features we did not need, such as cloud storage and facial recognition Vocabulary词汇
    The upgrade names specific features instead of saying some settings. Precise examples make the story more convincing and show a wider range of vocabulary.升级后的表达列出了具体功能，而不是笼统地说一些设置。精确的例子让故事更有说服力，也体现了更丰富的词汇量。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often say that privacy is leaked, but in English it is more natural to say privacy concerns or uneasy about our privacy. Do not translate the verb word for word; use noun collocations instead.中文里常说隐私被泄露，但英语更自然的说法是 privacy concerns 或 uneasy about our privacy。不要逐字翻译动词，而要多用名词搭配。
  • From Level 5 to Level 9 the story stays the same; only simple actions are replaced with more precise ones, such as combed through instead of read. This works better than simply making sentences longer.从 Level 5 到 Level 9，故事保持不变，只是把简单动作换成更精确的表达，例如用 combed through 代替 read。这比单纯加长句子更有效。

Three sample answers on the same plan同一骨架的三级示范

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1 84 words词

Last summer I went to a small beach town with my family. It was very beautiful, but there were too many people. The beach was dirty and the water had plastic bottles in it. We felt sad about this. So we picked up some trash for one hour. Then we told our friends to be careful when they travel. I learned that tourists can hurt a place. Now I always take my own bag and bottle. I think every traveler should do the same.

Points from this site used here:这一栏用到的本站知识点： Every clause needs a subjectArticles: a, the or nothingGradable and extreme adjectives: very tired, absolutely exhaustedEmphasis: do, own, very, whatsoeverModal nuance: will for habit, would for distanceTravel, flights and tourism

CELPIP 7–8 · ≈B2 116 words词

Last summer I took my family to a small beach town on the coast. The scenery was stunning, but the place was packed with visitors from all over the country. Litter covered the sand, and plastic bottles floated in the shallow water, which really upset us. Instead of just complaining, we spent an hour collecting rubbish along the shore with some local volunteers, who were just as worried as we were. Afterwards, we encouraged our friends to be more responsible when they travel. What I learned is that tourists can damage a place without realizing it. Since then, I always carry a reusable bag and bottle, and I believe every traveler should make the same effort.

Points from this site used here:这一栏用到的本站知识点： Giving reasons: as, since, due to, withwhat, whatever, whoever as noun clausesBeyond very good: stronger adjectivesLinkers without doublingPrepositions of time and place that differ from ChineseCollocations with make, do, take, have and giveTravel, flights and tourism

CELPIP 9+ · ≈C1 131 words词

Last summer I took my family to a small beach town on the coast. The scenery was stunning, but the place was packed with visitors from all over the country. Litter covered the sand, and plastic bottles floated in the shallow water, which genuinely upset us. Rather than simply complain, we spent an hour clearing rubbish along the shore with some local volunteers, who were just as worried as we were. Afterwards, we urged our friends to travel more responsibly. The experience taught me that even well-meaning visitors can quietly wear down the very place they love. Ever since, I have carried a reusable bag and bottle everywhere, and I truly believe that every traveler owes a place at least that much respect, even if it costs us a little convenience.

Points from this site used here:这一栏用到的本站知识点： Giving reasons: as, since, due to, withClauses of contrast and purposeGradable and extreme adjectives: very tired, absolutely exhaustedPresent perfect or past simpleDefining and non-defining relative clausesBeyond very good: stronger adjectivesNumbers, dates, prices and quantitiesPrepositions of time and place that differ from ChineseTravel, flights and tourism

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 The beach was dirty → Litter covered the sand, and plastic bottles floated in the shallow water Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 7 version replaces a vague, simple description with a concrete picture: litter on the sand and bottles floating in the water. Specific images make the story more vivid and show a wider range of vocabulary.7分版本用具体画面（沙滩上的垃圾、水里漂浮的瓶子）取代了笼统的简单描述，让故事更生动，也展示了更丰富的词汇。
  • 7–8 → 9+ tourists can damage a place without realizing it → even well-meaning visitors can quietly wear down the very place they love Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 9 version turns a plain statement into a more precise and idiomatic reflection. It shows that the harm is unintentional and gradual, which is a more thoughtful and natural way to express the lesson.9分版本把一句平淡的陈述改成更精确、更地道的感悟，指出伤害是无意的、逐渐发生的，表达更有思想，也更自然。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 So we picked up some trash → we spent an hour collecting rubbish Task Fulfillment完成任务
    The Level 8 version describes the action in a fuller way and adds the idea of acting together with local people. This answers the question ‘what did you do about it?’ with more detail and a clearer sense of purpose.8分版本对行动的描述更完整，还加入了与当地人一起行动的内容，对“你做了什么”这个问题回答得更详细、目的更清楚。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In Chinese people often just say there are too many people. A more natural spoken English option is ‘The place was packed with visitors’; packed with creates a stronger picture than too many people.中文里常说“人太多了”，英文口语里更自然的说法是 ‘The place was packed with visitors’，用 packed with 能让画面感更强，比 too many people 更高级。
  • When telling a personal story, keep the past tense consistent from ‘Last summer’ onward, then switch to the present tense only when you talk about your current habits, such as ‘Now I always carry a reusable bag’.讲个人经历时要用过去时态，从 Last summer 开始就保持一致；最后谈现在的习惯时再切换到现在时，例如 Now I always carry a reusable bag。

Prompt题目 53 Science and uncertainty科学与不确定

Talk about a time when you ignored a warning or a forecast and it turned out to be a mistake. What happened, and what did you learn about uncertainty? 请讲一个你忽视了警告或预报、结果证明是个错误的经历。发生了什么？你对“不确定性”有什么新的认识？

Plan: three points to cover提纲：要讲的三点
  1. Describe the plan and what the forecast said描述计划以及预报是怎么说的
  2. Explain what went wrong and how you felt说明出了什么问题以及你的感受
  3. Share what you learned about probability and uncertainty分享你对概率和不确定性的体会
Chunks from the same topic you could use可以用上的同主题词块
  • rather than /ˈrɑːðə ðæn/ 而不是
    A result that appears only once, in one laboratory, is best treated as a lead rather than a fact. How Scientists Measure What They Do Not Know
  • margin of error /ˈmɑːdʒɪn əv ˈerə/ 误差范围
    Journalists, for their part, are likely to serve readers better if they report the size of the margin of error alongside the dramatic number. Why Changing Our Minds Is Science Working
  • evidence /ˈevɪdəns/ 证据；支持某种观点或结论的信息
    On the whole, it is the clearest evidence that the system is doing its job, and a society that cannot tolerate that kind of honesty will end up believing something far worse. Why Changing Our Minds Is Science Working
  • by and large /ˌbaɪ ən ˈlɑːdʒ/ 总的来说
    It is a method for reducing error, and by and large it works because it admits that error is possible. Why Changing Our Minds Is Science Working
  • likely to /ˈlaɪkli tə/ 可能会
    Journalists, for their part, are likely to serve readers better if they report the size of the margin of error alongside the dramatic number. Why Changing Our Minds Is Science Working

Three sample answers on the same plan同一骨架的三级示范

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1 81 words词

Last summer I went hiking with my friends. The weather forecast said there was a sixty percent chance of rain, but I thought it was only a small risk, so I did not bring a rain jacket. After two hours, it rained very hard. We were wet and cold, and we had to walk back home. I felt bad about my choice. Now I know that a forecast is not a promise. I always check the weather and bring extra clothes.

Points from this site used here:这一栏用到的本站知识点： Every clause needs a subjectVerb and noun endings you cannot skipGradable and extreme adjectives: very tired, absolutely exhaustedNumbers, dates, prices and quantitiesWeather, climate, nature and the environment

CELPIP 7–8 · ≈B2 123 words词

Last summer I planned a day hike with a few friends in the mountains. The weather forecast said there was a sixty percent chance of rain, but I dismissed it as a minor risk, so I left my rain jacket at home. About two hours into the trail, the sky turned dark and the rain came down hard. We were soaked and freezing, and we had no choice but to turn back before reaching the lake. On the drive home, I felt embarrassed about my poor judgment. I realized that a forecast is a statement about probability, not a promise, and that sixty percent is far from small. Since then, I always read the forecast carefully and pack extra layers, just in case.

Points from this site used here:这一栏用到的本站知识点： Countable and uncountable nounsEvery clause needs a subjectVerb and noun endings you cannot skipReal conditionals and time clausesParticiple clausesNumbers, dates, prices and quantitiesPrepositions of time and place that differ from ChineseWeather, climate, nature and the environment

CELPIP 9+ · ≈C1 137 words词

Last summer, a few friends and I set out on a day hike in the mountains. The forecast put the chance of rain at sixty percent, yet I dismissed it as a minor risk and left my rain jacket at home. Roughly two hours up the trail, the sky darkened and the rain came down in sheets. We were soaked and shivering, and we had no choice but to turn back before reaching the lake. On the drive home, I felt thoroughly humbled by my own overconfidence. It struck me that a forecast expresses probability rather than certainty, and that sixty percent is hardly negligible. Ever since, I read the forecast with care, pack an extra layer or two, and treat any uncertainty as a reason to prepare rather than a reason to hope for the best.

green绿色 = new compared with the level below＝比下一级新加的说法 · dashed虚线 = what the next level replaces＝下一级要换掉的说法 · underlined下划线 = a point taught on this site (tap to open it)＝本站教过的知识点（点开去学）

What changes from level to level每升一级换了什么

  • 5–6 → 7–8 I thought it was only a small risk → I dismissed it as a minor risk Vocabulary词汇
    The Level 7 wording replaces a plain, vague phrase with a more precise verb. Dismissing a risk shows that the speaker actively judged it and got it wrong, which makes the story clearer and more natural.7 分版本用更精确的动词 dismissed 取代了平淡含糊的说法。“dismiss a risk”表明说话人主动做了判断却判断错了，故事更清晰自然。
  • 7–8 → 9+ I felt embarrassed about my poor judgment → I felt thoroughly humbled by my own overconfidence Content / Coherence内容与连贯
    The Level 9 wording names the real lesson, overconfidence, instead of only saying the speaker felt embarrassed. It adds depth of reflection and uses a more precise, idiomatic collocation.9 分版本点出了真正的教训——过度自信，而不只是说“感到尴尬”。反思更深入，搭配也更地道、更精确。
  • 5–6 → 7–8 we had to walk back home → we had no choice but to turn back Listenability好懂程度
    The Level 8 wording uses a fixed expression that flows smoothly in speech and sounds more natural than a simple past-tense sentence, so the listener follows the story easily.8 分版本使用了固定表达 no choice but to，说起来流畅自然，比简单过去式更地道，听者更容易跟上故事。
Notes on this prompt这道题的讲解
  • In speech, people say ‘a sixty percent chance of rain’ rather than translating the Chinese phrasing word for word. ‘Chance’ sounds more natural and conversational than ‘probability’.口语里说天气概率，常用 a sixty percent chance of rain，而不是直译“概率是百分之六十”。chance 比 probability 更口语、更自然。
  • After ‘no choice but to’ you must use the base form of the verb, as in ‘had no choice but to turn back’. Do not leave out ‘to’ and do not use an -ing form.no choice but to 后面必须接动词原形，例如 had no choice but to turn back。不要漏掉 to，也不要写成 turning。

Rate yourself on the four dimensions按四个评分维度自评

Listen back to your recording. Compare it with the three sample columns and pick the closest level for each dimension.回放你的录音，和三栏示范比，每个维度选最接近的级别。

🆚 What each level sounds like on this task这个任务上各级别听起来什么样

For every prompt we wrote three versions: Level 5–6, 7–8 and 9+. The skeleton is the same; each level adds to the four rating dimensions. Find the column that sounds most like you, then see which sentences the next column changes.同一道题，我们写了三个级别的示范：5–6 级、7–8 级、9 级以上。内容骨架一样，差别只在四个评分维度上一级一级往上加。先找到和自己最像的那一栏，再看下一栏把哪几句换掉了。

CELPIP 5–6 · ≈B1
  • The events are in order, but there are no feelings or thoughts at the time.按时间顺序讲完了，但只有事件，没有当时的感受和想法。
  • Almost all short simple-past sentences, few clauses.几乎全是一般过去时的短句，很少用从句。
  • A one-line lesson at the end, very brief.结尾有一句「学到了什么」，但很简短。
CELPIP 7–8 · ≈B2
  • The story has a shape: set-up (I thought I had time), problem, solution, result.故事有起伏：铺垫（以为时间很多）→问题→怎么解决→结果。
  • Feelings (panic, embarrassed, relieved) and a line or two of dialogue.加了感受（panic、embarrassed、relieved）和一两句对话。
  • Past continuous and would have: more accurate tenses.用了过去进行时、would have 等，时态更准确。
CELPIP 9+ · ≈C1
  • Carefully chosen details put the listener there (an off-key birthday song, a knot in the stomach).细节精挑细选，一个画面就让人身临其境（跑调的生日歌、胃里打结）。
  • Storytelling linkers and patterns: to make matters worse, only to, not only ... but also.讲故事的衔接语和句型：to make matters worse、only to、not only … but also。
  • The ending is a real reflection, not a stock phrase.结尾是一个有分量的反思，不是套话。

Why people get stuck at 7为什么常卡在 7 级

  • The story is told but not every part of the prompt is answered (why it was memorable, what you learned). The official Level 5 sample did exactly that: what happened, not why.故事讲完了，但没有回答题目里的每一个问题（为什么难忘、学到什么）。官方样本里 5 级的问题正是只讲了「做了什么」。
  • The only feeling words are happy, sad and nervous.情绪词只有 happy、sad、nervous 三个。
  • Every sentence joined with "and then", so it sounds like a list.每句都用 and then 接，听起来像流水账。

Three moves to 9+冲 9 级以上的三步

  • Before you speak, choose one vivid detail and say it precisely in one sentence.开口前选一个最有画面的细节，用一句话把它说具体。
  • Keep two storytelling linkers ready (to make matters worse, luckily, in the end) and use at least one every time.准备两个讲故事的衔接语（to make matters worse、luckily、in the end），每次至少用一个。
  • End with what the experience changed in you, not "it was a nice day".最后一段说「这件事改变了我什么」，而不是「那天很开心」。

📘 Template and phrases模板与常用句

Strategy策略

  • Decide on one story fast and stay with it.30 秒内马上定一个故事，不要换来换去。
  • If you cannot think of a real one, make one up.想不出真事就现编，评分看的是英语，不查事实。
  • Past tense, descriptive details, and how you felt.用过去时，加细节（时间、地点、人、感受）。

Tips提醒

  • The story doesn't need to be dramatic. An ordinary small event told clearly is enough.故事不用惊天动地，普通小事讲清楚就行。
  • Use the past tense throughout: was / went / told. Mixing in the present tense loses points on how it sounds.全程过去时：was / went / told。现在时混进来会扣听感分。
  • If you have time left, add a feeling or a small detail. Don't stay silent.时间还剩就加一个感受或一个小细节，别沉默。

Template模板

Set the scene开头：时间 + 地点 + 谁A few months ago, I was … when …
What happened发生了什么（2–3 个动作）First, … Then, … After that, …
Result and feeling结果 / 感受In the end, … I felt really …
Wrap up一句收尾It was a great experience, and I learned that …

Phrase bank句子库

  • A few months ago, … 几个月前……
    A few months ago, I started a new job in Richmond.
  • It was a …day 那是个……的一天
    It was a cold and rainy day.
  • At first, … but then … 起初……但后来……
    At first I was nervous, but then everyone was very friendly.
  • I couldn't believe it when … 当……时我简直不敢相信
    I couldn't believe it when I saw the price.
  • Luckily, … 幸运的是……
    Luckily, a kind stranger helped me.
  • In the end, … 最后……
    In the end, everything worked out.
  • I felt so … 我觉得特别……
    I felt so relieved.
  • It took about … minutes 大概花了……分钟
    It took about forty minutes to fix.
  • That was when I realized … 那时我才意识到……
    That was when I realized I had the wrong address.
  • I'll never forget … 我永远忘不了……
    I'll never forget how kind she was.
